scope: Bounded independent pre-output source/contract review; no local model construction, inference, weights, tokenizer download or heavy installation.
authorized_next_action: One already-authorized hosted-only native Qwen3-ASR0.6B FP32 development screen on the original eight clips, subject to its frozen protocol and independent semantic review.

source_findings.detail: Exact public native -hf revision7f1569a48a89f3e3f4dc3a5c9d28bddd903bc76c; all small runtime files actually hashed and large model/tokenizer identities labelled published LFS. Hosted downloader checks actual bytes/hash before offline local loading and after execution.

Original dataset row/id/reference/audio hash and complete decoded PCM hash/sample count are bound. The native feature-extractor observer requires the exact full prepared float32 array once, with no VAD/crop; exact mel/mask dimensions and audio placeholders are checked and bound to the actual audio encoder.

Official Qwen3ASRForConditionalGeneration/Processor, CPU-only Torch, explicit FP32/eager, max4 selected CPUs and1 interop thread, trust_remote_code=False, local_files_only=True, sanitized offline environment and socket audit hook. Actual call supplies full audio and language=None only; original references are never supplied to generation.

Raw prefix and every generated token stream are checkpointed, returned token IDs are compared to the stream, native EOS is required with no internal/post-EOS tokens, raw decode is retained before native repetition repair, and the parser-rewrite flag is explicit. Native emission tokens are not fabricated word timestamps.

Controller samples owned group RSS/time and worker records peak/times. Final cleanup now terminates surviving owned group members even after leader exit; success requires an exited leader and no live group members. The exact before/after no-model probe passes. This is sampled process-group enforcement, not a kernel allocation cap or whole-machine approval.

Read-only repository permissions, nonpersisted checkout credentials, isolated pinned runtime, separate input/model preparation, hosted-only model loading, and always-upload evidence path excluding weight directory.

All8direct package Python requirements and active cross-constraints among selected pins satisfy Python3.12/Linux. Transformers5.13 accepts tokenizers0.22.2,hub1.5.0,safetensors0.8.0 andnumpy2.5.5. Official CPU-wheel metadata hash is independently verified. Hosted pip still must resolve/install transitive dependencies and prove actual imports.

reviewed_issue_resolved.before: A child survived when its leader exited0 before terminate_owned was called.
reviewed_issue_resolved.after: The identical no-model probe leaves no live child; the controller now records cleanup and rejects success when live members or an unexited leader remain.

limitations: This is pre-output contract/source review plus a narrow no-model cleanup reproduction and validate-only check. No new recognition output or inference/resource success is claimed.
Declared package constraints are compatible, but actual hosted pip installation/imports must still pass and be retained.
The resource budget covers the observed owned process group, not the whole application or machine; sampled scans may miss transient peaks.
No Greek forced aligner or word timestamp accuracy is claimed. Native raw text, including any repetitions/omissions/names/numbers/negation errors, must be independently judged.
All eight clips are previously exposed development evidence, not fresh validation. No production/default change or full-film follow-up is approved by this review.
